RULES: How to play: Swipe, drag, or use the arrow keys to move the tiles. Tiles with the same number merge when they touch. Add them up to reach {{target}}!
CONFIRM: Start a new game? Your current progress will be lost.
RULES_PERKS: The ringed tiles on the ladder earn perks. Tap a perk to use it.
PERK_UNDO_INFO: Undo takes back your last move.
PERK_DOUBLE_INFO: Double points doubles your merge points for 5 moves.
PERK_UPGRADE_INFO: Upgrade doubles a tile below your highest.
PERK_SAVE_INFO: Save keeps this moment, so you can come back here once if you lose.
PERK_SAVE_DONE: Game saved. If you lose, you can reload it once.
PERK_SWAP_PICK: Tap the first tile to swap.
PERK_SWAP_PICK_SECOND: Tap a neighbouring tile to swap with.
PERK_RESCUE: Use a perk to keep going.
